next_question: On the same verified-reachable stdlib HTTP substrate, stop measuring how often work repeats and instead measure what is epistemically visible to an executor: define D(s) = the correct next action of a span as a function of the executor's own observable state, and decompose the deopt ratchet's residual into (i) merely-novel spans that close when a no-memory executor is given the goal/intent as a conditioning prefix while inducing no parameters and retaining no compiled memory, (ii) epistemically blocked spans where byte-identical observations require different correct actions and only parameter induction or persistent cross-episode memory can bind them, and (iii) observation-absent spans whose binding key is not present in the conditioning context at all. Measure the three shares as a function of residual-novelty rate on the pre-declared {0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00} grid, with a planted-disambiguation positive control (goal-distinct, observation-identical work items whose binding key is carried in the goal), a matched null in which states are rendered unique by construction so that shares (ii) and (iii) must be exactly 0, and this packet's unconditioned B-NO-MEMORY-DETERMINISTIC arm as the reference arm. Falsifier: if share (ii) is 0 within the plan family, the ratchet's residual is irreducibly binding and inherited parameterization has a real economic niche; if the conditioned arm reaches or exceeds this packet's measured compiled-replay coverage (0.6857 of deterministic span occurrences, 0.40 of all span occurrences) at equal or lower amortized cost, then goal conditioning substitutes for inherited parameterization and SPIDER's mechanism-accumulation premise is falsified in setting on identified, executable arms.
reason: Adjudication rests on three upstream artifacts only: producer result.json (status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED, falsifier_triggered=false), independent audit.json (status REVISE, producer_claim_supported=false, claim_ceiling=DEOPT_RATCHET_BEATS_COLD_ON_THIS_PLAN_FAMILY / INHERITED_LEG_NOT_IDENTIFIED) and the frozen design in spec.json, prereg.md, freeze.json, whose three input hashes I re-verified against freeze.json and whose 31 declared artifacts are all present with matching sha256. WHAT THE PACKET ESTABLISHES: one leg of the three-way comparison is identified and positive - a no-memory compiled executor with a selective deopt ratchet is cheaper than always-deopting cold exploration at matched correctness (38.6 vs 72.0 abstract units/episode, all three arms success 1.0, paired bootstrap deopt-minus-cold -33.4, CI95 [-34.0, -32.4], n=50) - and it stays cheaper at every one of the five pre-declared novelty rates. It also establishes a clean bounded economic datum for the target claim: at fixed task length, cost is monotone in residual novelty. The compilability boundary is quantified and decomposed: 0.5833 of span occurrences are witnessed-deterministic, only 0.6857 of those are actually served from compiled replay, 0.40 of all spans, and the 220-occurrence loss splits into 100 observationally-identical-but-goal-distinct state keys, 100 state keys that never recur because they embed an episode-specific previous request, and 20 first-two-witnesses. It further establishes, as an operational diagnostic about the incumbent arm, that the shipped kernel under the preregistered configuration cannot execute anything it distils (0 of 1200 EXECUTABLE resolutions, 0 bind/verify/freshness calls, PC-EXACT-REPLAY 0 of 48), with the blocking scalar confirmed at src/spider/kernel.py line 59 (min_confidence default 0.8) versus line 90 (distill confidence=0.5), gate at line 114, and no distill_parameterized anywhere in src/. WHAT THE PACKET DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the decisive leg. Because the incumbent arm executed zero mechanisms, its cost (72.0) is exactly the mandatory null's cost (72.0), so the only difference between inherited execution and inheritance ablation is a registry the incumbent can never use. The frozen rule's DEOPT_DOMINATES classification is therefore mechanically correct and scientifically narrow, and reading it as a falsification of SPIDER's central inheritance premise would convert a missing measurement into a negative scientific result, which the packet contract forbids. The headline 0.5833 determinism fraction is a property of an experimenter-authored plan at a pre-declared novelty rate, not a measured constant of real agent work; the cost model is preregistered abstract units against a perfect deterministic oracle with token and browser quantities null; success 1.0 reflects a perfectly deterministic self-authored CRUD substrate with no DOM, auth, rate limiting, partial failure or adversarial content. No claim is VALIDATED (audit is not PASS), none is PRODUCT_CORE (wrong lane, no PASS, no promotion intent), and SHIPPED is not the Director's to emit. Claim consequence is therefore a single conservative move: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY HYPOTHESIS -> EXPERIMENTAL, bounded at the auditor's own ceiling, with the falsifier explicitly recorded as not triggered. Immediate chaining is set to false because the next informative step needs a different lane's deliverable (an executable inherited arm from the owning lanes) or a substrate that does not yet exist (a captured real agent-work trajectory distribution), and because a NEW frontier experiment requires a Global Research Director mandate rather than a lane Director's dispatch. Frontier must not re-plan a repaired copy of an unidentified instrument, so the carried question moves to a materially orthogonal object - decision-observability and goal conditioning rather than repetition frequency - which is also the only route to an identified comparison against memory on a substrate that is already verified reachable.
